query: Which active-learning sampling policies and stopping criteria (uncertainty, disagreement, expected utility) maximize adjudicator efficiency for top-k reviews?

response.query: Which active-learning sampling policies and stopping criteria (uncertainty, disagreement, expected utility) maximize adjudicator efficiency for top-k reviews?
response.answer: Active-learning sampling policies like uncertainty and disagreement, along with stopping criteria such as expected utility, maximize adjudicator efficiency for top-k reviews by focusing on the most informative samples and halting when performance gains are minimal.

results.content: These studies, all of which are available as appendixes to this report, examine: • Department of Commerce [Appendix B] • Department of Health and Human Services (Medicare coverage and payment) [Appendix C] • Departments of Homeland Security and Justice (immigration) [Appendix D] • Department of Labor (black lung benefits) [Appendix E] • Department of Veterans Affairs (veterans disability compensation) [Appendix F] • Equal Employment Opportunity Commission [Appendix G] • Federal Energy Regulatory Commission [Appendix H] • Merit Systems Protection Board [Appendix I] • National Labor Relations Board [Appendix J] • Social Security Administration [Appendix K] In selecting cases, we followed contemporary best practices in qualitative analysis and sought a representative sample of adjudicative systems that contained useful variation on a variety of important dimensions.102 When considering agencies for inclusion in our study, we contemplated, inter alia, agency mission, policy, and structure; the type of claims involved;103 the 101 While we consulted some works on timeliness in judicial decision making for background on delays and backlogs the context of executive-branch decision making, we largely constrained our review of the literature to research on administrative agencies.

results.title: Student Code of Conduct - Alexandria City Public Schools
results.content: # Student Code of Conduct. The ACPS Student Code of Conduct is designed to:. 1. Encourage all students to engage in behaviors that promote learning and keep ACPS school environments safe and orderly. 2. Inform the ACPS community of the possible consequences that address behavior infractions. 3. Promote opportunities for all ACPS students to acquire the social, emotional and academic skills to succeed as citizens in our global community. In all we do, the ACPS learning community strives to live these core values:. By signing and returning the **ACPS Signature Form** in the ACPS Back to School Guide (for more information, click on this link or visit the ACPS website and search for "*back to school guide*"), parent(s)/guardian(s) shall not be deemed to waive, but do expressly reserve, their rights protected by the Constitution or laws of the United States and/or the Commonwealth of Virginia, and shall have the right to express disagreement with the school division’s policies and or decisions.
